reusableHarness.changes: Adds --minecraft 1.18.2 and opt-in --mixin-audit; install/run select the version from the directory marker; default 1.19.4 behavior remains. Fabric distribution completeness is checked before staging.
reusableHarness.validation: Python compile, real no-Java stage for 1.18.2 and default 1.19.4, and exact recheck of both actual exported target audits. The dedicated runs above used the recorded external cache adapter and earlier frozen base script bytes, before these CLI changes.

preservedNotices: Mixin verbose mode reports upstream compatibility/class-version warnings and unavailable optional Fernflower decompiler. Exported classes and guard invocation were verified; no decompilation is claimed.
Forge first-run configuration generation, loader library mods.toml warnings, union resource URL notices and vanilla command ambiguity warnings remain in the original log.
Fabric loopback suite uses offline-mode and produces its normal security warning; handleDisconnection() called twice notices are preserved.
The successful runs have zero ERROR-severity lines, which does not mean their logs are warning-free. The historical failed fixture contains a real startup error.
limitations: Synthetic self-reports are not trustworthy client/hardware attestation. No real VM detection or cheat-client accuracy experiment was performed here.
Fabric protocol branch checks shorten report timeouts and raise historical-account/rate limits; this is not a test of every default policy value.
No Grim or AntiXray was installed, and no performance, arbitrary modpack, proxy, old-world migration or gameplay acceptance is claimed.
The two running servers and installers were serial. Both completed with exit 0 and their loopback ports were released before handing memory to rendered-client validation.
